relationships.subject: NGF
relationships.evidence_quote: NGF promotes MSC fibrotic commitment through the TrkA and hypoxia-inducible factor-1α (Hif1α) signaling pathways

relationships.subject: nociceptive sensory neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Nociceptive sensory denervation alleviated the progression of fibrosis at days 14 and 28 post-injury

relationships.subject: NGF
relationships.evidence_quote: NGF derived from nociceptive sensory neurons plays a specific pro-fibrotic role

relationships.subject: TPX-0005
relationships.evidence_quote: a clinically used TrkA inhibitor, partially reverses excessive fibrosis

key_findings: Nociceptive sensory neuron-derived NGF drives Prrx1+ MSC fibrotic commitment and tendon fibrosis via TrkA and Hif1α.
The TrkA inhibitor TPX-0005 partially reverses excessive fibrosis.
